title: Na Maro Na Maro Mujhe
body:
Na maaro na maaro mujhe(2)
Mein sakina mein sakina mein yateema hoo mujhe Pathar pathar na maaro
Mein baba ki raaj dulaari
apne chacha ko jaan se pyaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Mein pardesi hoo dukhyari
dekh rahe ho aawo zaari
Margaye waris ab tanha hoo
Mein sakina....
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani mangu toh mat dena
seekh liya hai pyaasi rehna
Guth kar jeena guth kar marna lekin yeh kaisa hai kareena
Dekh lo nabze mein laasha hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba se thi jung tumhari
bacho se kya hai bezaari
Saans ruk jaati hai hamari
chalne mein bhi hai dushwaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaar baras ki zaeefa hoo
Khoon rawa kaano se hamare
Tumune tamache itne maare
Kaash jo ammu hote pyaare
<<DIVIDER>>
so gaye wo toh neher kanaare Phir bhi dekho zinda hoo
Chin gaya mujhse aapka seena
Bhool chuki hok raat ko sona
Dard ka takiya ghum ka bichona
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaas lage toh aansoo peena
ek diya jalta bhujta hoo
Ghar se chali toh shehzaadi thi
Ranjo alam ki kab aadi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qismat mein yeh karwa di thi
Paani ki kab faryaadi thi
Naado paani mein tishna hoo
Besar laashe gaur andhera
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon ki boo hai ghum ka pehra
Zakhm kaleje ka hai gehra
Aansoo hai rukhsaar pe thehra
Chaar baras ki zaaefa hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
Pursa hai yeh rehano raza ka
Ae shahzaadi dard ki malika
Haay tera taboot na utha
Tera toh marqad qaidi tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti rahi tu mein dukhiya hoo
